title: Unprotected `updateDynamicLPFee` Allows Arbitrary LP Fee Manipulation by Malicious Hooks or Impostors
impact: A pool configured with a dynamic fee mechanism relies on its hook contract to call `updateDynamicLPFee`. Because `updateDynamicLPFee` does not verify whether the caller is actively executing a hook transaction or whether the pool is locked/unlocked, any contract (or if a hook is upgradable/compromised) can arbitrarily set the pool's LP fee up to `MAX_SWAP_FEE` (`1e6` / 100%), allowing malicious actors to sandwich users, trap funds, or drain pools through exorbitant fees.
